manifest.description: Upload files, screenshots and images to your Fileship and shorten links.

popup.shortenPageDescription: Create a short link to the current tab
popup.captureVisibleDescription: Upload a screenshot of what you see
popup.captureAreaDescription: Drag over the page to choose what to capture
popup.connectDescription: Add your server address and upload token to start uploading.

upload.title: Upload to Fileship
upload.description: Files are uploaded with the upload options from the settings.
upload.dropDescription: Or choose them from this computer.

tasks.title: Recent
tasks.empty: Uploads and short links show up here.

options.title: Fileship settings
options.description: Upload files, screenshots and images from this browser and shorten links.
options.connectionDescription: The Fileship server this browser uploads to.
options.uploadTokenDescription: Copy it from Settings → Integrations on your Fileship. It can only upload files and shorten links, and it is kept in this browser only.
options.canUploadAndShorten: This token can upload files and shorten links.
options.canUploadOnly: This token can upload files but cannot shorten links.
options.canShortenOnly: This token can shorten links but cannot upload files.
options.uploadOptionsDescription: Used for files, images and screenshots uploaded from this browser.

area.hint: Drag to choose an area, click to capture the visible page, press Esc to cancel

errors.notConfigured: Connect your Fileship in the settings first.
errors.permissionDenied: Fileship needs access to {origin} to upload there.
errors.hostPermissionMissing: The extension can no longer reach {origin}. Save the connection again in the settings.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach your Fileship server.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to respond.
errors.notFileship: No Fileship server was found at {url}.
errors.serverStarting: This Fileship server is still starting, try again in a moment.
errors.serverTooOld: This server runs Fileship v{version}. The extension needs v{minVersion} or later.
errors.invalidToken: The upload token is not valid. Copy it again from Settings → Integrations.
errors.noPermission: Your account cannot upload files or shorten links on this server.
errors.cannotUpload: Your account cannot upload files on this server.
errors.cannotShorten: Your account cannot shorten links on this server.
errors.noLink: The server did not return a link.
errors.imageAccessDenied: Fileship needs access to {origin} to download this image.
errors.pageNotSupported: Only http and https pages can be shortened.
errors.interrupted: The browser stopped this task. Try again.
errors.fileMissing: The file is no longer available. Choose it again.
